description:
Are you trying to decide whether to rent out your home or have you tried to sell it and no one is interested? Allow me to offer an alternative with owner financing. If you are in the Temple, Killeen, Belton, or Salado areas, it's important to explore all your options and this is one that might work for you. As a local Bell County real estate expert, I break down the pros, cons, and some of the hidden risks of both strategies so you can make the most informed decision for your property.

Owner financing allows you to act as the bank, potentially securing a higher sales price and passive income, while renting keeps the asset in your portfolio. Which is right for your Texas home? Let’s dive in!
